recipes.d: Chunky soup with paprika
steps: Dice the potatoes, carrots and onion.
Soften the onion in oil, stir in paprika, then add the other vegetables.
Add rinsed lentils, stock and enough water to cover; simmer until soft.
Serve hot, adjusting the amount of water as needed.

recipes.d: Tomato rice with chickpeas and peppers
steps: Finely chop the onion and peppers and soften in a deep pan.
Stir in rice, paprika and chopped tomatoes.
Add enough water to cook the rice and simmer until tender, topping up as needed.
Add drained chickpeas for the final 5 minutes and serve piping hot.

recipes.d: Tender cauliflower and beans with a cheesy crust
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and steam the cauliflower until nearly tender.
Melt butter, stir in flour and gradually whisk in milk until the sauce thickens.
Mix the cauliflower, drained butter beans and sauce in a baking dish; top with cheese.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.d: Creamy risotto with leeks and parmesan
steps: Slice and wash the leeks and mushrooms, then soften in butter.
Stir in risotto rice for one minute and add a ladle of prepared hot stock.
Keep stirring and adding stock gradually until the rice is creamy and cooked, around 20–25 minutes.
Stir through parmesan and serve immediately.

recipes.d: No-cook tuna and bean salad
steps: Drain the tuna and rinse the beans.
Wash and dice cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Mix lemon juice and olive oil as a dressing.
Toss all ingredients together and serve immediately.

recipes.d: Golden fishcakes with soft sweet potato
steps: Peel and boil the sweet potatoes until tender; drain well and mash.
Cook the salmon through, remove any bones and mix the flaked fish with mash and lemon juice.
Shape into patties, dip in beaten egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry until golden and piping hot; serve with cooked peas.

recipes.d: Chicken, noodles and broccoli in broth
steps: Dice the chicken, slice the carrots and chop the broccoli.
Bring prepared stock and ginger to a simmer; add chicken and carrots until the chicken is thoroughly cooked.
Add broccoli and noodles and simmer until tender following packet directions.
Serve immediately, checking everything is piping hot.

recipes.d: Soft potato and leek layers under cheddar
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan); thinly slice the potatoes and washed leeks.
Soften leeks in butter and warm the milk in a pan.
Layer potato, leeks and some cheese in a baking dish; pour over milk.
Cover and bake until potatoes are soft, then uncover, add remaining cheese and brown the top.

recipes.d: Savoury lentil and carrot pastry pockets
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan); soften diced carrots and onions.
Stir through drained cooked lentils and cumin and heat until the filling is fairly dry.
Cut the pastry into rectangles, add cooled filling and fold and seal the edges.
Brush with beaten egg and bake until golden, cooked through and hot inside.

recipes.d: Fresh bulgur with chickpeas and lemon
steps: Cook bulgur according to the packet and drain any excess water.
Drain and rinse chickpeas and dice the cucumber.
Mix the bulgur with chickpeas, cucumber, lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve warm or chill promptly for a cold salad.

recipes.d: Sausages and vegetables with lentils
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cut the vegetables into even pieces.
Toss vegetables with paprika and a little oil, and arrange sausages on top.
Roast until sausages are fully cooked and vegetables tender, turning halfway.
Add drained cooked lentils, heat through and serve.

recipes.d: Jacket potatoes with mild chicken chilli
steps: Prick and microwave potatoes in batches until tender all the way through.
Soften the onion and brown chicken mince in a pan until thoroughly cooked.
Add cumin, drained kidney beans and passata, then simmer until thick.
Split potatoes, top with hot chilli and serve.

recipes.d: Warm wraps packed with beans and vegetables
steps: Soften chopped peppers and cumin in a pan.
Add drained beans and tomatoes and simmer until the chilli thickens.
Spoon filling and cheese onto wraps, then fold closed.
Toast in a dry pan until the cheese has melted and serve hot.

recipes.d: Pasta with creamy beans and kale
steps: Boil pasta as directed, reserving some cooking water.
Remove tough kale stems, chop leaves and cook until tender.
Warm drained beans with garlic and cream cheese, loosening with pasta water.
Stir in pasta and kale, finish with lemon and serve hot.

recipes.d: Rice with shredded cabbage and egg
steps: Cook rice and use promptly while hot, or chill rapidly before reheating.
Finely shred cabbage and carrots and stir-fry until tender.
Push vegetables aside and scramble eggs until completely set.
Add rice and soy sauce; stir-fry until piping hot and garnish with spring onions.

recipes.d: Golden squash and lentil soup
steps: Dice peeled squash, carrots and onions; rinse lentils.
Soften onions, then add cumin and the other vegetables.
Add lentils, stock and enough water to cover; simmer until everything is tender.
Blend carefully if desired and serve hot.

recipes.d: Pork strips with noodles and cabbage
steps: Cook noodles following their packet instructions.
Slice pork thinly and shred cabbage and carrots.
Stir-fry pork with ginger until cooked through, then add vegetables until tender.
Toss in noodles and soy sauce and heat until piping hot.

recipes.d: Oven-baked tomato gnocchi and beans
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and prepare gnocchi according to the packet.
Combine gnocchi, drained beans, passata and spinach in a baking dish.
Scatter mozzarella over the top and cover for the first part of baking.
Bake until bubbling and thoroughly hot in the centre.

recipes.d: Vegetables, hummus and couscous bowls
steps: Heat oven to 210°C (190°C fan) and chop squash, courgettes and peppers evenly.
Toss in oil and roast until tender and lightly browned.
Prepare couscous according to its packet and fluff with a fork.
Spoon hummus into bowls, add couscous and vegetables and finish with lemon.

recipes.d: Potatoes and tuna beneath a golden cheese crust
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); thinly slice and parboil potatoes until nearly tender.
Melt butter, stir in flour and gradually whisk in milk to thicken.
Layer potatoes with tuna and cooked peas, then pour over sauce and top with cheese.
Bake until bubbling and potatoes are tender throughout.
